title: [29.X]-Dispute Status code is not retained in some scenarios within the Vendor/Purchase Side, but works well in Customer/Sales side
summary: Dispute status is now retained when editing vendor ledger entries and purchase invoices, matching the behavior that already works correctly on the sales side.
key_points: Dispute status preservation logic added to vendor entry editing workflows

Both vendor ledger entry page and purchase invoice header edit codeunits updated

Fixes behavior inconsistency between vendor and customer ledger entry editing
